instructions: See docs/positions-lookup.md. Fill in "positions" for each player, most natural first, using only values from "allowed". The first must come from "primaryMustBeOneOf". Set confidence to high, medium or low.

players.name: Ashley Young
players.note: FBref records him DF-first in each of these seasons, which is wrong for all of them: at Watford and Aston Villa he was an out-and-out left winger, with 9 goals and 14 assists in 2007/08, and played no defensive role.

players.name: Anton Ferdinand
players.note: Centre-back who came through at West Ham filling in at right-back.

players.name: Danny Higginbotham
players.note: Left-sided defender who filled both centre-back and left-back.

players.name: Charles N'Zogbia
players.note: Natural left-sided attacker, but as a teenager at Newcastle he filled in at left-back, which is what FBref recorded him as.

players.name: Mikel Arteta
players.note: Central midfielder at Everton, used right of a midfield three as well as centrally.

players.name: Earl Barrett
players.note: Right-back at Villa, centre-back earlier at Oldham.

players.name: Cesc Fàbregas
players.note: A central midfielder throughout 2004/05, playing alongside Vieira and Gilberto. The FWMF label would make a forward position his primary one, which is plainly wrong for this season.

players.name: Jim Magilton
players.note: Magilton was a central midfielder throughout his Southampton and Sheffield Wednesday years and never played as a defender, so FBref's DF-primary DFMF label admits no true answer.

players.name: Dean Whitehead
players.note: FBref putting DF first is wrong: Whitehead was Sunderland's captain in central midfield and played the same holding role at Stoke, where he only occasionally filled in at right-back.
